note: Re-quoted 2026-11-25 to the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0; library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz, read offline as owb-am), per the founder decision of 2026-11-18 (Amharic quotes OWB everywhere). This supersedes what the notes below say about the 1962 UBS Bible and about wording borrowed from other Amharic works: every `mined` row is now a verbatim OWB span in its block (exact OWB pieces may be joined with '…'); `self_rendered` rows are allusions and paraphrases left as the translator's prose. Block indices were corrected to the requote_inventory numbering.

Scripture authority is the 1962 Amharic Bible (UBS; NT revised 2003). NT verses are pasted from the ebible mirror (amh_amh); the mirror has no OT, so OT quotations are self_rendered in the 1962 register unless a shipped Amharic work already quotes the verse (source_file names it).

Rows come from the translators' reports and every 'mined' claim was re-verified: each quoted fragment must be a byte-exact substring both of this body and of the NT file (or of the cited shipped work); a claim that fails is recorded as self_rendered. Some mirror entries are merged verse ranges holding only part of the text, so verses inside them are self_rendered.
